preconditioning.notes: BMW US page: battery preparation starts automatically when navigating to a DC station and can be started manually from the Central Display or My BMW app.

capacity_usable_kwh.notes: Estimated: same Neue Klasse pack and charger as the iX3 50 xDrive (and iX4), for which BMW US states 112.2 kWh usable. Conflict: BMWBLOG says 108.7 kWh for the i3 50 xDrive (evspecifications 108.7 net, the European figure); no BMW US i3 page states capacity.
BMWBLOG: "usable battery capacity is rated at 108.7 kWh for the i3 50 xDrive".

chemistry.notes: Estimated: evspecifications lists the i3 50 xDrive cell as NCM cylindrical (EVE Energy); BMW US says only "new cylindrical cells".

published_10_80_min.notes: BMWBLOG: 10-80 % in 21 minutes at an 800V DC station.
